patch.value: Windows copied agent plugins cannot install pinned runtime through npm.cmd

CodeRabbit review on PR #1292 found that the new generated Claude/Codex plugin resolver calls spawnSync("npm.cmd") without a Windows command processor. Node 24 cannot execute .cmd directly, so a copied plugin with an empty cache cannot complete its first pinned install on Windows. Preserve exact-version, atomic, offline behavior and prove actual Windows command transport in the required regression job.

A copied Claude or Codex plugin with an empty cache installs its exact matching pm-cli runtime on Windows Node 24 through a safely bounded npm.cmd invocation; staging paths with spaces and shell metacharacters are preserved; generated launchers remain byte-identical; a native Windows regression exercises the command transport and required PR checks pass.
